block_a.qa_note: GLOWING gold blade throughout (matte-lock violation). Needs MATTE re-roll.

block_b.qa_note: GLOWING gold blade + baked white/yellow energy-beam VFX at f48 + mid-clip back-turn rotation. Needs MATTE, facing-locked re-roll.

victory.qa_note: MATTE single steel tanto (single wielded blade + a sheathed backup on the back = design, not dual-wield), faces right at f0 and f96, anchor-locked. Green-keyed clean (no fringe). CAVEAT: mid-clip flourish turns near-frontal (chest toward camera ~f30-54) before returning to the right-facing anchor; acceptable for a one-shot taunt but flagged. Top blade edge-feathered (--top 48).
